verdict.rationale: ROS 2 covers only the data-capture end of this loop. rosbag records and plays robot data, a Python API reads and writes bags from your own code, and the docs explicitly mention saving synthetic data for training sets. Nothing in the evidence shows a training-pipeline integration or a way to deploy updated models back to a fleet. missing for 10: model-training pipeline integration, model versioning/registry, fleet-wide model deployment/OTA rollout, independent corroboration of an end-to-end data-to-model loop.
